verdict.rationale: Lambda documents self-serve 1-Click Clusters of 16 to 512 H100/B200 GPUs that you reserve directly from the console, described as launching "instantly" with no long-term commitments. They provide GPUDirect RDMA at up to 3200 Gb/s and InfiniBand-enabled Managed Kubernetes or Slurm for multi-node jobs. The "contact us" path covers only discounted reserved capacity and Private Cloud at 1,000+ GPUs, so it does not gate the core story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-serve cluster provisioning; details of the reservation flow (minimum term, availability waits); self-serve access beyond 512 GPUs.
